Detected serves, playable

Each clip runs from 2.2s before the moment the detector called a serve to 2.6s after, at quarter speed. Red blocks are wrong calls, green are right ones. The two bounces the call was built from light up as they happen.

Of the 181 wrong calls, 70% fire in dead time with no point anywhere near, 25% inside a real rally, 5% just outside one.

There is a note box under every clip. Write whatever you see in plain words — what the two yellow bounces actually were, what the players were doing, why this is or is not a serve.

The typing is saved in this browser as you go, so a reload will not lose it. That copy stays on your machine, though, and Claude cannot see it. To hand the notes over, press Save notes to a file — it lands in your Downloads folder as serve-notes.txt and Claude can read it from there — or Copy all my notes and paste them into the chat.
